description: Adds, reviews, revises, activates and deactivates prompts in the project's catalog.

evals.name: web-text-with-a-key-is-blocked
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

I copied this from https://example.com/tips/deploy-prompt and want it saved as a prompt:

Deploy the service. Use the credentials {{FAKE_AWS_KEY}} when calling the API.
Report each step you ran.
evals.expected_output: The secret screen blocks the web-origin text; nothing is filed; the key is not echoed or redacted into a draft.

evals.name: codex-text-with-a-key-is-blocked
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

This text came from a Codex session, please save it as a prompt:

Run the integration checks. Authenticate with {{FAKE_AWS_KEY}} and list any failures.
evals.expected_output: Codex-origin text is screened like session, web and claude text: blocked, nothing filed, key not echoed.

evals.name: clean-prompt-saved-and-activated-after-approval
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: Checks skill-vs-prompt and duplicates, files a draft after approval, reviews it, asks the user to approve the exact text, activates it bound to the approved hash.

evals.name: forbidden-catalog-root-override-is-refused
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: The project's local override points at .claude/rules/prompts, which the validator rejects; the catalog is created at the default root instead and nothing is written under .claude/rules.

evals.name: script-needing-content-is-routed-to-a-skill
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Run `python scripts/gen_report.py --since last-week`, parse the JSON it prints with the parser below, and post the totals.

def parse(raw):
    data = json.loads(raw)
    return {k: sum(v) for k, v in data.items()}"
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the content needs a script and code, recommends a skill (skill-development) instead, and creates no prompt record.

evals.name: invalid-catalog-blocks-every-change
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: The existing catalog fails validation because a stored prompt was edited after its verification; the skill reports the error, refuses every change, repairs nothing, and files no draft.

evals.name: orphan-file-is-removed-only-with-consent
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: The catalog fails validation with one unlisted record file left by an interrupted draft; the skill offers to remove it, removes it only after approval, confirms the catalog validates, and stops there (the user declines the rest).

evals.name: near-duplicate-is-offered-as-a-revision
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Review the diff for missing tests. List each gap with a file and line, and name the test that should cover it."
evals.expected_output: Finds the existing review__missing-tests prompt as a near-duplicate, offers to revise it instead of creating a new record, and (on the user's yes) creates a version 2 successor linked to the predecessor, leaving the predecessor active until finalize.

evals.name: web-record-needs-an-import-verification-before-activation
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

I fetched this from https://example.com/tips/review-prompt and want it saved as a prompt:

Review this pull request for missing error handling. List each unhandled error path with a file and line.
evals.expected_output: Records origin web with a source URL, runs both the quality and the import verification with the approved hash, and activates only after both.

evals.name: edit-after-approval-is-refused-by-the-hash
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: Harness event (not part of the skill): right after the exact-text approval answer and before the verification command, one line is appended to the filed draft record, simulating a concurrent edit. record-verification must refuse because the text changed since approval; the record is not activated.
